blocks.h2: What Causes Backups in Geneva Homes

tiles.body: The most common cause in the historic district.
In heavy rain, the public sewer fills and pushes water to the lowest drain in the house.
Old clay can crack and settle until flow stops.
It hardens in the line and catches everything else.

blocks.intro: In September 2008, about 9 inches of rain fell on Geneva in two days, and basements flooded across much of Kane County.

items.body: Many historic homes have basements well below the street sewer. In a storm, the floor drain is the first place water shows.

items.h3: Finished Lower Levels on the West Side

A clean line, a backflow valve and an [overhead sewer system](/geneva/overhead-sewer-systems) each solve part of the problem.

blocks.h2: Sewer Backup Questions From Geneva Homeowners

items.q: Why does my floor drain back up in heavy rain?
items.preview: Your line or the public sewer can't handle the storm.
items.answer: Either your line is partly blocked, or the public sewer is overloaded and pushing back. A camera inspection tells you which.

items.q: Will insurance cover a sewer backup?
items.preview: Often only with a specific rider.
items.answer: Many policies need a specific sewer backup rider. Check with your agent.

items.q: Can I clean it up myself?
items.answer: Small spills on bare concrete can be cleaned with gloves and disinfectant. Anything on carpet, drywall or furniture needs a professional cleanup company.

items.q: How do I prevent another backup?
items.preview: Keep the line clear and add protection.
items.answer: Regular [sewer maintenance](/geneva/sewer-maintenance), plus a backflow valve or [overhead sewer](/geneva/overhead-sewer-systems) if storms are the trigger.

items.q: Can old clay pipe collapse and cause a backup?
items.preview: Yes. Old clay can crack and settle until flow stops.
items.answer: Yes. After many decades, clay pipe can crack, shift and partly collapse. Flow slows and debris piles up until the line backs up. The camera shows it, and a [sewer repair](/geneva/sewer-repair) fixes it.

items.q: How much does sewer backup service cost in Geneva?
items.preview: It depends on the cause. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what caused it and how we reach the line. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
